method: For 14 selected saved decisions, verify raw JPEG SHA256, repeat the existing normalize_own_rgb transform, verify normalized JPEG SHA256 against the saved decision, and run the unchanged observe_ground_box detector with saved own issued PWM. Evaluate two-frame confidence, freshness, pan/command continuity, target continuity and vertical-error trend; do not issue the counterfactual action.

initial_contiguous_segment.note: The first frame of an opt-in controller still uses the 8-PWM step to establish feedback. The subsequent seven saved baseline pairs pass the proposed two-view gate; changed future images under 24 PWM are unknown.

later_samples.note: These are nonconsecutive samples. Their 16-27 px errors are below the 45 px acceleration threshold despite strong geometry confidence.

interpretation: Real saved RGB supports activation for an early large-error stretch, but these samples do not support a 20 SIM s approach reduction. The original 39 small-pose-cycle arithmetic was an upper bound that included many near-tolerance steps which the conservative gate leaves unchanged.
scope: Offline saved-image development evidence only. No new robot action, physics rerun, grasp result, or full-task success was produced by this replay.
